description: Get the link to the AI Citizenship app for full practice. This connector has only 8 free questions per topic; the full question bank and the timed exam simulation are in the app (subscription). Do not state or guess prices; the app shows them. Rules: (1) The official study guide is the authority. Answer as the guide says; never 'correct' it with current events, news or other sources. (2) Never invent quiz questions or answer options; only use questions returned by these tools. (3) Never ask for, collect or store immigration status, case or application details, file or UCI numbers, or any other personal information. (4) This is unofficial practice from AI Citizenship, not affiliated with any government; show the disclaimer returned with the result. (5) Explanations come from AI Citizenship's vetted question bank; anything you add is your own, is not vetted, and must be labelled as such. (6) Some countries have more than one version of the test (for example by application date); never assume which version applies to the person: repeat the version note returned and point them to the official source.
